title: Neon API key: one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 2 inputs are identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). Legacy mutation notes: prefix namespace: NAPI_ vs the provider-documented lowercase napi_ and prefix namespace: nopi_ vs the provider-documented napi_ (one-letter deviation). Twin of "Neon API key: must be flagged".
rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.

expectation.rationale: Negative twin of neon-api-key-api-key-create: prefix namespace: nopi_ vs the provider-documented napi_ (one-letter deviation). Exactly one structural property differs from the positive; silence follows from construction.
